turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually just got back from doing some laps in the local pool. It felt so good to just glide through the water and focus on my breathing for an hour. My wrist is feeling totally fine with it too, which is a huge relief.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, she's really hitting her stride there. It's a lot of long shifts, but she finds it incredibly rewarding. She actually had a rare night off yesterday, so we got to spend some quality time together.

turns.text: That's lovely. It must be so nice to sync up your schedules when you both have such demanding careers. Speaking of busy schedules, how is your brother Kwame doing with his marathon training down in Atlanta?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's impressive! Marathon training is no joke. Since you had that great session in the water today, are you planning to do any climbing this week, or are you sticking to lower-impact activities for now?
